description: ACCDB (r-q47 follow-up): seeds T(ID PK, G LONG, B BIGINT) with G=1..10 (G=1 small+Null, G=2 2147483647+2147483648, G=4 Null, G=5 min+max, G=6 min alone, G=7 max alone, G=8 min+0, G=9 (min+1)+max, G=10 min+1). Isolates SUM(B), AVG(B), MIN(B), MAX(B), COUNT(B), COUNT(*) individually on G=5 and SUM/AVG separately on G=6..10 via both DAO and ADO with full metadata.
